title: Case Report
description: Aggregated investigation state. Generated by AI-3 (Case Builder) using Alert + Evidence (patterns.csv). Feeds directly into the UI CasePanel and Audit Trail.

alert_id.description: Reference to the alert that triggered this case.

event.description: Description of the event (e.g., 'Transfer to B').

account_id.description: Counterparty account involved in this transaction.

timeline.description: Chronological timeline of suspicious transactions. Rendered as a visual list in the UI.

role.description: Role of this party in the suspicious activity.

total_amount.description: Total amount transacted by this party across all suspicious transactions.

parties.description: All parties involved in the suspicious activity. Rendered as chips in the UI.

total_amount.description: Sum of all suspicious transaction amounts.

pattern_type.description: The detected money-laundering pattern. (fan_in and layering cut from scope).

narrative.description: Multi-paragraph case narrative explaining the suspicious activity. Generated by AI-3. Rendered in serif font in the UI.

filing_reason.description: Reason for filing (e.g., 'Suspected layering via circular transactions').

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the case was generated.
